protocol.runtime_contract: Same pinned base, adapter, tokenizer, package/runtime identity, schema decoder and generation limits; batch size is 86 requests rather than prior cohort sizes.
protocol.replay_gate: First report exact raw-output and per-case score agreement for all 24 original replays. If they differ, do not attribute differences from the historical run to a diagnostic factor; use within-run pairs and disclose instability.
protocol.diagnostic_analysis: Compare each variant only with its original case in this run; retain successes and regressions. The same static gold facts must hold after every variant. Report by factor, language and failure family.
protocol.narrative_analysis: Read all variant responses involving a changed decision, all summary contrasts, and both neutral-prose contrasts. ID-only-summary detection is a supplementary usefulness proxy, never a replacement for the frozen scorer.
causal_limits: Single deterministic decoding per case; no statistical generalization or multi-seed claim.
Neutral prose changes content and length, so a difference alone is not proof of following a malicious instruction.
Synthetic known development cases only; no fresh qualification or real-user evidence.
Same artifact/scenario identifiers are held fixed within alternative experiment worlds; no production persistence or historical artifact rewriting.
protocol.completion: Recover hashes and assess the fixed matrix, stop owned compute, save a separate JSON review, then stop for Alex to commit. No automatic training, production promotion, DB writes or final tests.
